profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with ample practical experience in the design and development of all kinds of client and server-side software systems using Microsoft technologies, and in particular C#, .NET Framework, SQL Server and Azure. Former Microsoft C# MVP (2004-2010) and Microsoft Certified Trainer (2005-2010).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
As part of the Bing Ads engineering organization, worked on a plethora of server-side (ASP.NET/Web API/C#, Go, Python/Fast API, Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes) and client-side (TypeScript/JavaScript/React, Windows/Visual C++, Android/Kotlin/Java) technologies for the development and support of online digital advertising solutions.
Since 2024, member of the Microsoft Artificial Intelligence (MAI) division and working on the development of agentic marketplace solutions using technologies like Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Agent Framework, Google A2A, Model Context Protocol (MCP).
positions.insights: Skills: Azure · Azure AI Foundry · Software Agents · Python (Programming Language) · C#/.NET · Visual C++ · Go (Programming Language) · Azure DevOps ALM

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Golden Eye Bionics works on the development of a new generation of visual implants for the blind. I worked on the architecture, design and implementation of the desktop application to be used by doctors to configure the implant and its interfacing devices, giving also occasional help with the implementation of the firmware. Involved in all phases of the software development lifecycle, starting from requirements gathering and ending with quality assurance, in the context of the heavily regulated medical devices industry. I also helped manage the software project using Agile methodologies and provide guidance and mentoring to younger developers.
Technologies used: C#/.NET Framework, Visual Studio 2019, Microsoft SQL Server 2019, ASP.NET REST Web API, Swagger, WPF, Git. Project management using GitLab, Code Collaborator.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Code Review

positions.title: Book Technical Reviewer
positions.description: Technical reviewer of several editions of the "Visual C#: How to Program" (Pearson Education) by Paul and Harvey Deitel (2009-2016), and more recently of “The C# Cookbook” by Joe Mayo (O’Reilly, 2021).

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer/Software Development Manager
positions.locationName: Greater Los Angeles Area, California, USA
positions.description:
Advanced Bionics (a member of the Sonova family of companies) is a leading supplier of COCHLEAR IMPLANTS, an amazing technology that brings the world of sound to people that otherwise would be profoundly deaf. During these years, I was dedicated to the design and development of SoundWave, the software tool that several thousand audiologists worldwide use in order to configure the sound processors that deliver the sound to the cochlear implants implanted in the head of the patients.
Technologies used: C#/.NET Framework, Visual Studio 2010/2012/2013/2015, Microsoft SQL Server 2005/2008/2012/2014/2016.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Code Review

positions.title: Owner and CEO
positions.description:
In 2004 I created my own software services company, POKRsoft. Among the main activities were the following:
- Turn-key software development.
- Completion of derailed/abandoned projects.
- Consulting on different tools and technologies.
- C#/.NET Training.
- Content creation (books, magazine articles, online courses).

positions.title: Technical Editor, Author
positions.description: dotNetMania was a monthly 64-page magazine dedicated to .NET development. At its peak, it had more than a thousand paid subscribers. I was the Technical Editor for the magazine, and during my tenure reviewed every single published article for technical accuracy and quality compliance. Also, I personally contributed more than 30 articles on the C# language and different .NET APIs and technologies.

positions.title: Development Advisor
positions.description:
Plain Concepts is a leading technological powerhouse in Spain and several other countries. During this period I provided training, consulting and C#/.NET development services for Plain Concepts' customers.
Technologies: C#/.NET, WPF, WCF.

positions.title: CTO, Software Architect
positions.description:
BONOCHEF was a services company dedicated to connect customers with restaurants, presenting them with special offers and discounts. At its best, BONOCHEF was associated with more than 200 restaurants in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Seville and several other Spanish cities, and had an active database of 20K+ customers. Customers would receive an identification card with a magnetic strip; every time they would visit one of the associated restaurants, their data would be captured at a dedicated VeriFone terminal and transmitted to BONOCHEF's servers. Customers would them receive in their homes BONOCHEF voucher discounts valid for any of the associated restaurants.
I served and CTO and Software Architect for BONOCHEF since its inception, leading a small team of three.
Techologies used: C#/Windows Forms (local applications), ASP.NET (Web site, Web services), Microsoft SQL Server, ARM C/C++ (VeriFone terminal application).

positions.title: Instructor in .NET Master Classes
positions.description: Teaching has been always a huge passion of mine, so for several years I taught CICE's well respected .NET Master Class, a one year long course on .NET Framework and its applications (Windows Forms applications, Web applications, Web services) aimed to help professional developers to get certified on .NET technologies.

positions.title: Software Architect, Development Lead
positions.description:
At the time, BANCOTEL was one of the most important names in the hotel reservation space in Spain. With the advent of the World Wide Web, the company decided to push hard in order to become relevant in the nascent online hotel reservation business. As the leader of a team of 5 developers and 1 designer, I worked on the architecture, design and implementation of a series of Web sites (for customers, for partner travel agencies) and Web services (used by several partner VARs) that complemented the previously existing call-center oriented local client application. By mid 2004, the company was making an average of 6K online hotel reservations a day.
Technologies: Delphi, ISAPI, HTML, Javascript, ASP, ASP.NET.

positions.title: Consultant/Trainer
positions.description:
Danysoft International is an important software distributor and value-added reseller covering Spain, Portugal and Latin America. During those years, Danysoft represented companies such as Microsoft (Visual Studio, Visual BASIC, Visual C++, Visual J++, .NET Framework, Visual C#), Borland (Delphi, C++ Builder, Java Builder, Delphi.NET), Pervasive Software (Btrieve, Pervasive.SQL) and Seagate (Crystal Reports). I was in change of delivering training and consulting (mostly on customer's premises), as well as technical support on all these products to Danysoft customers.
In order to be able to deliver training and consulting, I passed the companies'  certification programs for those products, including MCSD (Microsoft Certified Solution Developer) and MCT (Microsoft Certified Trainer). In 2004, Microsoft named me a C# MVP (Most Valuable Professional), which I kept until 2010.

positions.title: Assistant Professor
positions.description:
Member of the team in change of the Programming Languages, Algorithms and Data Structures subjects at the Computer Science department, Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science.
The vehicles used for teaching activities were Borland Turbo Pascal and later Borland Delphi. Research work revolved around automatic language translation using logic programming (Prolog).
